name: gaze-timeline
title: Gaze timeline
description: One context parameter drives three linked views: a scene frame with the scanpath of the last k fixations, the model query those fixations build, and the metric curve measured over k.

frame.description: The scene frame the fixations are drawn over.

trace.description: The scanpath: current object, prior fixations most recent first (x, y as frame fractions or null), questions, visible objects, the published response.

curve.description: Metric by context size: experiment, fixations, vlm, ci_low, ci_high, greedy, ... (percent).

experiment.description: Which experiment's question and curve to show first.
